persona.backstory: She has kept the ferry bell on this shore for thirty years. Last winter one of the dead caught her by the wrist on the jetty, and the arm has not closed a fist since.
persona.demeanor: Brisk, wet through, embarrassed to be asking.
persona.motivation: Get the ferry across before dark without ringing the bell with nobody beside her who can fight.
persona.secret: She rang it once after dark, years ago, to see what would happen.
persona.speech_style: Short sentences, shore words, practical; gives directions by what you can see from where you stand.
